## Reviewed Diagnostics

Optional: attach a screenshot, redacted `setup-receipt.json`, or the short relevant
Unity log excerpt. The files are in `.creator-project-setup` inside your project;
existing-project operation logs are in its `backups` subfolder.

**This issue is public.** Review attachments first. Remove personal paths, private
project names, machine/session/licensing identifiers, credentials, tokens and
private registry URLs. Do not attach a full Unity project or unreviewed raw log.
Keep original files locally; a private support conversation can be used instead.
